A. He will call either Ben or Amy. B. He will either call or text Ben. C. He will both call and text Ben.

【選出比較接電話對象的一句。】

D021. Use ordinary standard agreement for two singular names: Either Ben or Amy ___ ready.

A. is B. are C. be

【Ben 或 Amy 已準備好。】

D022. Use ordinary standard agreement for two plural groups: Neither the boys nor the girls ___ late.

A. were B. was C. is

【男孩們和女孩們都沒有遲到。】

D023. Use the usual nearest-subject pattern: Either the teacher or the students ___ coming.

A. are B. is C. am

【老師或學生們會來。】

D024. Use the usual nearest-subject pattern: Either the students or the teacher ___ coming.

A. is B. are C. am

【學生們或老師會來。】

D025. Use the usual nearest-subject pattern: Neither the coach nor the players ___ ready.

A. are B. is C. am

【教練和球員都沒有準備好。】

D026. Use the usual nearest-subject pattern: Neither the players nor the coach ___ ready.

A. is B. are C. am

【球員和教練都沒有準備好。】

D027. Choose the normal written subject forms.

A. Either he or she will attend. B. Either him or her will attend. C. Either his or hers will attend.

【選出代名詞正確充當主語的一句。】

D028. Choose the normal written object forms.

A. I invited either him or her. B. I invited either he or she. C. I invited either his or hers.

【選出代名詞正確充當受詞的一句。】

D029. Complete the prepositional objects: This is for either you or ___.

A. me B. I C. my

【這是給你或我的。】

D030. Choose the normal agreement with the nearer singular noun: Neither the assistants nor the manager ___ arrived.

A. has B. have C. are

【助理們和經理都未到。】

D031. Choose a sentence meaning that neither book was bought.

A. I bought neither book. B. I didn't buy both books. C. I bought one book.

【選出清楚表示兩本書都沒有買的一句。】

D032. Complete the standard negative list: We didn't buy tea ___ coffee.

A. or B. nor C. but also

【我們沒有買茶,也沒有買咖啡。】

D033. Which sentence means not all two items were purchased, but one may have been?

A. I didn't buy both books. B. I bought neither book. C. I bought both books.

【選出表示「沒有兩本都買」,但仍可能買了一本的一句。】

D034. Choose the sentence that uses the negative correlative rather than a second not.

A. Neither Ben nor Amy was invited. B. Neither Ben nor Amy wasn't invited. C. Ben didn't neither call nor write.

【選出普通標準英文的否定配對寫法。】

D035. Choose the meaning of: Neither the red key nor the blue key works.

A. Both keys fail. B. Exactly one key works. C. Both keys work.

【選出這句關於兩把鎖匙的正確意思。】

D036. Complete the negative: The keys were neither on the desk ___ in the drawer.

A. nor B. or C. and

【鎖匙不在書桌上,也不在抽屜裏。】

D037. Which sentence says a person may do either activity, not necessarily both?

A. She may either stay or leave. B. She must stay and leave. C. She has stayed and left.

【選出提供兩種可能活動的一句。】

D038. Choose the sentence that negates both actions yesterday.

A. He neither called nor texted yesterday. B. He called but didn't text yesterday. C. He didn't call but texted yesterday.

【選出表示他昨天兩件事都沒有做的一句。】

D039. Which sentence negates the object, not the action itself?

A. She bought neither the red book nor the blue one. B. She neither bought a book nor borrowed one. C. She bought a red book and a blue one.

【選出否定所買的兩本書、而非兩種動作的一句。】

D040. Choose the standard connector in a plain negative list: There were no pens, pencils ___ rulers.

A. or B. nor C. either

【沒有原子筆、鉛筆或間尺。】

D041. Choose the sentence that gives two alternative conditional possibilities.

A. If either Ben or Amy can come, we'll go ahead. B. If neither Ben nor Amy can come, we'll cancel. C. Both Ben and Amy must attend.

【選出只要兩人其中一位能來便繼續的一句。】

D042. Complete the past form: Yesterday she either ___ home or took a taxi.

A. walked B. walks C. walking

【昨天她步行回家,或乘的士。】

D043. Complete the present perfect pair: She has neither called nor ___.

A. written B. wrote C. writing

【她一直沒有致電,也沒有寫信。】

D044. Complete the future pair: He will either arrive early or ___ after lunch.

A. come B. comes C. came

【他會提早到達,或午飯後才來。】

D045. Choose the sentence with the correct inversion after independent nor.

A. She didn't call, nor did she write. B. She didn't call, nor she did write. C. She didn't call, nor wrote she.

【選出 nor 接另一個否定子句時的標準語序。】

D046. Complete the reply to a negative: “I can't swim.” “Neither ___ I.”

A. can B. do C. am

【「我不會游泳。」「我也不會。」】

D047. Choose the response that can mean “I also haven't eaten.”

A. I haven't either. B. I have also. C. Either have I.

【選出表示「我也未吃」的一句。】

D048. Complete the paired negative: Neither the manager ___ the assistant signed.

A. nor B. or C. and

【經理和助理都沒有簽署。】

D049. Complete the formal negative continuation: He was not at home, nor ___ his brother.

A. was B. isn't C. not was

【他不在家,他的兄弟也不在家。】

D050. Choose the construction that describes an alternative without using a correlative pair.

A. We can meet on Monday or Tuesday. B. We can meet Monday nor Tuesday. C. We can meet Monday but also Tuesday.

【選出只用普通 or 也正確的一句。】

C｜意思理解(D071–D080)

D071. Which difference is correct? “I didn't buy both bags” versus “I bought neither bag.”

A. The first may mean I bought one; the second means I bought none. B. They always mean exactly the same thing. C. The second means I bought both bags.

【比較 not both 和 neither 的真正意思。】

D072. Interpret “You may email the office or call the teacher.” Is contacting both automatically forbidden?

A. No, the permission may allow both unless stated otherwise. B. Yes, or always forbids both. C. The sentence says neither method is allowed.

【這句是否一定禁止兩種聯絡方法都用?】

D073. What does “Neither the red bus nor the green bus goes to Central” tell us about a third blue bus?

A. It says nothing definite about the blue bus. B. The blue bus must go to Central. C. The blue bus cannot go to Central.

D074. “Either Maya or Leo will open the shop.” What is being offered as alternatives?

A. The person who will open the shop. B. The colour of the shop. C. The date when the shop opens.

【這句比較的是哪一部分?】

D075. Why is “You can neither stay nor leave” different from “You can either stay or leave”?

A. The first denies both possibilities; the second offers alternatives. B. Both offer the same permission. C. Both say two people are leaving.

【比較兩句對行動可能性的意思。】

D076. “I don't like either option.” Which nearby sentence has approximately the same negative meaning?

A. I like neither option. B. I like both options. C. I like one option very much.

【這句否定兩個選項的意思。】

D077. What is special about “Neither do I” after “I don't smoke”?

A. It uses an auxiliary before I to agree with a negative statement. B. It is a two-part neither ... nor noun phrase. C. It means I smoke too.

【分清短回應和兩段式連接詞。】

D078. In “We can either walk, cycle or take the bus,” why might some editors prefer a different wording?

A. Either is most commonly used for two choices; a three-option list can be written without it. B. Because the word cycle is not English. C. Because or cannot connect activities.

【三項清單中 either 的用法有甚麼風格限制?】

D079. In “His age is neither here nor there,” what is most likely meant?

A. His age is irrelevant to the discussion. B. His age is unknown because he moved away. C. He is physically in neither place.

【理解固定說法,避免逐字翻譯。】

D080. Which statement about “Either the alarm failed or the door was open” is safest?

A. The sentence suggests alternatives; the context is needed to decide whether both could have happened. B. Both definitely cannot be true in English grammar. C. Both must definitely be true.

【兩種可能是否一定互相排斥?】

本學生版練習完結。 如果一道題能有不同自然答案,先看看英文指示有沒有指定寫法及意思。

# PART X — Final Coverage Check｜學完後自己檢查

學完本指南,你應該能用自己的話回答以下問題,不用背每條規則的編號。

**基本:**我能分清 either ... or 是提出選擇,neither ... nor 是兩邊都不符合。

**真正意思:**我知道 either ... or 在某些情況不一定禁止兩邊同時成立。

**範圍:**我能找出兩部分是人、物件、動作、描述、時間、地點還是整個句子。

**配對:**我知道普通寫法通常是 either ... or、neither ... nor,不會隨意混用。

**名詞:**我知道名詞、冠詞、物主字和介詞要按各自意思選擇。

**動詞:**我能把兩個動作放在相配的位置,並保留動詞所需的介詞。

**單複數:**我能分清兩個單數主語、兩個複數主語,以及兩邊不同數量的情況。

**代名詞:**我會按主語或受詞的位置選 he/him、she/her、I/me 等。

**否定:**我知道 neither 本身有否定意思,通常不用再加 not。

**not both:**我知道「不是兩個都」不一定等於「兩個都不是」。

**時間:**我會檢查 will、can、has、had 與後面動詞的正確寫法。

**條件:**我能理解 if either ... or 和 if neither ... nor 的不同。

**省略:**我知道甚麼時候可以共用主語、動詞、介詞或受詞,也知道省略不能改掉意思。

**多項:**我知道三項以上的清單可能有其他更清楚的寫法。

**相近句型:**我能區分 both ... and、whether ... or、not ... either 和 neither ... nor。

**倒裝:**我知道 Neither do I 和 nor did she write 與普通 neither A nor B 不同。

**固定說法:**我能理解 either way 和 neither here nor there,而不只逐字翻譯。

**不確定時:**我會先把句子說清楚,再判斷形式;不會把少見但合理的寫法直接說成錯。

最後五個問題:

我要說的是兩個選擇,還是兩邊都否定?

either ... or 或 neither ... nor 到底連接哪兩部分?

動詞形式有沒有配合真正的主語和時間?

把句子換成另一種寫法後,否定範圍或人物有沒有改變?

完整英文句子是否自然,中文意思是否一樣?

**最後提醒:**配對連接詞不只是背兩組英文。真正重要的是看清楚誰做事、選甚麼、否定哪一部分,以及句子所指的範圍。有疑問時,寧願把句子寫得更清楚,也不要硬套一條沒有例外的規則。
